description: Deterministically validates and minimizes an explicitly operator-supplied Utah Business List XLSX into a package accepted by the legacy offline validator.
redirect_policy: No HTTP requests or redirects are permitted.
retry: No automatic retry; correct or replace the operator-supplied workbook explicitly.
checkpoint: No partial package is published. selection.json is written last in staging and the closed package directory is renamed atomically before legacy validation.
idempotency: The original XLSX SHA-256, replay version, exact three-sheet schema and explicit package ID bind the output.
cancellation: Abort cooperatively before parsing each sheet and before publication; remove only the replay-owned staging or just-published package.
retention_profile: Retain the operator workbook and privacy-minimized JSONL locally. Applicant, person, principal-address and unrestricted information values are blanked before JSONL output.
